scenarios.q: Do Indian citizens need a visa for Japan?
scenarios.answer:
- Yes, Indian citizens need a tourist visa to visit Japan.  
- The visa is obtained through the Japan eVISA system.  
- Processing time is about 5 working days.  
- Passports must be valid for the entire stay.  

[visa/japan.md]

scenarios.q: How do I reach Gold status in your loyalty program?
scenarios.answer:
- Earn 5 points per $1 spent on flights and 10 points per $1 on hotels【policies/loyalty.md】  
- Accumulate 50,000 points to reach Gold status  
- Gold benefits: free seat selection, lounge access, priority check-in【policies/loyalty.md】  
- You can also redeem points (100 points = $1) toward future bookings【policies/loyalty.md】

scenarios.q: What does SkyWay Protect insurance cover and what does it cost?
scenarios.answer:
- Cost: 6 % of the total trip value (must be bought within 14 days of the initial booking)【policies/insurance.md】  
- Coverage:  
  • Trip cancellation for medical reasons  
  • Lost baggage up to $2,000  
  • Flight delays longer than 6 hours  
  • Emergency medical expenses up to $100,000【policies/insurance.md】
